mapper.select: SELECT id, evaluation_no, company_id, period_year, period_half, evaluation_type, evaluator_user_id, status, total_score, max_total_score, score_percentage, qualified, qualification_threshold, comment, submitted_at, approved_by, approved_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_evaluation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT ev.id, ev.evaluation_no, ev.company_id, c.name AS company_name, ev.period_year, ev.period_half, ev.evaluation_type, ev.evaluator_user_id, eu.name AS evaluator_name, ev.status, ev.total_score, ev.max_total_score, ev.score_percentage, ev.qualified, ev.qualification_threshold, ev.comment, ev.submitted_at, ev.approved_by, au.name AS approver_name, ev.approved_at, ev.rejected_reason, ev.created_at, ev.updated_at FROM tb_evaluation ev LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ev.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user eu ON eu.id = ev.evaluator_user_id AND eu.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.id = ev.approved_by AND au.deleted = 0 WHERE ev.id = #{id} AND ev.deleted = 0

SELECT ev.id, ev.evaluation_no, ev.company_id, c.name AS company_name, c.business_number, ev.period_year, ev.period_half, ev.evaluation_type, ev.status, ev.total_score, ev.max_total_score, ev.score_percentage, ev.qualified, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_evaluation_attachment a WHERE a.evaluation_id = ev.id) AS attachment_count, ev.submitted_at, ev.created_at FROM tb_evaluation ev LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ev.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY ev.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_evaluation ev LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ev.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_evaluation ( evaluation_no, company_id, period_year, period_half, evaluation_type, evaluator_user_id, status, total_score, max_total_score, score_percentage, qualified, qualification_threshold, comment, submitted_at, approved_by, approved_at, rejected_reason, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{evaluationNo}, #{companyId}, #{periodYear}, #{periodHalf}, #{evaluationType}'REGULAR', #{evaluatorUserId}, #{status}'DRAFT', #{totalScore}, #{maxTotalScore}, #{scorePercentage}, #{qualified}, #{qualificationThreshold}60.00, #{comment}, #{submittedAt}, #{approvedBy}, #{approvedAt}, #{rejectedReason}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_evaluation SET total_score = #{totalScore}, max_total_score = #{maxTotalScore}, score_percentage = #{scorePercentage}, qualified = #{qualified}, comment = #{comment}, qualification_threshold = COALESCE(#{qualificationThreshold}, qualification_threshold), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_evaluation SET status = #{status}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_evaluation SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_evaluation SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{approverUserId}, approved_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE tb_evaluation SET status = 'REJECTED', approved_by = #{approverUserId}, approved_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), rejected_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
